situations.title: 영양 요구·경로 사정
situations.tagline: He hasn't eaten in days — how is he getting any nutrition?
situations.brief: 환자의 영양 요구를 사정하고 장관 영양을 우선하는 경로를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We usually feed through the gut with a small tube first.
It's the safest way to give him nutrition right now.
The team calculates exactly what he needs.
goals: 장관 영양 우선 원칙을 가족에게 설명한다

situations.title: 장관영양 시작·내성 관찰
situations.tagline: We're starting tube feeds — can you watch her residuals and belly?
situations.brief: 장관영양을 시작하고 위잔여량과 복부 상태로 내성을 관찰하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll start at the ordered rate and check residuals.
Let's watch for distension or discomfort.
I'll keep the head of the bed elevated.

situations.title: 영양관 위치 확인
situations.tagline: Before we feed, let's confirm the tube placement with an x-ray.
situations.brief: 급식 전 영양관 위치를 영상으로 확인해 안전을 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's verify placement before anything goes through the tube.
I'll hold feeds until the x-ray is confirmed.
Documenting the tube position now.
goals: 급식 전 영양관 위치를 정확히 확인한다

situations.title: 흡인 예방 체위
situations.tagline: Why does the head of my bed have to stay up while I'm being fed?
situations.brief: 급식 중 흡인 예방을 위한 두부 거상 체위를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Keeping you upright helps the feed stay down safely.
It lowers the risk of food going into your lungs.
I'll help you get comfortable in this position.
goals: 급식 중 두부 거상의 목적을 설명한다

situations.title: 배변·복부 팽만 관찰
situations.tagline: My stomach feels really bloated and full — is that normal?
situations.brief: 배변 양상과 복부 팽만을 관찰해 위장관 기능을 평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me check your belly and listen for bowel sounds.
Tell me if it becomes painful or harder.
We'll adjust the feeding if your stomach is too full.

situations.title: 혈당·전해질 연계 감시
situations.tagline: Now that feeds are running, how often should we be checking her glucose?
situations.brief: 급식에 따른 혈당과 전해질 변화를 연계해 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's check her glucose on the ordered schedule.
I'll watch the electrolytes as the feeds increase.
We'll adjust insulin coverage as needed.

situations.title: 장관영양 불내성 관리
situations.tagline: Her residuals are high again — should we slow the rate and add a prokinetic?
situations.brief: 장관영양 불내성에서 속도 조절과 위장관 촉진제로 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's reduce the rate and reassess her tolerance.
A prokinetic may help her gut move the feed along.
I'll keep her head elevated and watch for distension.

situations.title: 재영양증후군 예방
situations.tagline: He's severely malnourished — let's start feeds slow and watch for refeeding.
situations.brief: 심한 영양불량 환자에서 재영양증후군을 예방하며 서서히 급식하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's start low and advance the feeds slowly.
I'll monitor phosphate, potassium, and magnesium closely.
We'll replace electrolytes before they drop too far.

situations.title: TPN 적응·관리
situations.tagline: His gut isn't tolerating feeds — should we move to TPN through the central line?
situations.brief: 장관영양이 어려운 환자에서 TPN 적응과 중심라인 대사 관리를 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm the central line and start the TPN safely.
I'll monitor his glucose and electrolytes closely.
We keep strict line care to prevent infection.

situations.title: 복강내압 측정
situations.tagline: His belly is really distended — can you measure a bladder pressure for me?
situations.brief: 방광압 측정을 통해 복강내압을 평가하고 추세를 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll set up and measure the bladder pressure now.
Let's trend it and watch for a rising number.
I'll report the value to the physician right away.

situations.title: 복부구획증후군 조기 인지
situations.tagline: His pressure keeps climbing and his urine's dropping — could this be compartment syndrome?
situations.brief: 복부구획증후군의 조기 징후를 인지하고 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Rising bladder pressure with low urine worries me.
Let's track his organ function and pressures closely.
I'll alert the physician about the trend.

situations.title: 영양 목표 열량·단백 조정
situations.tagline: Can we review whether his calorie and protein goals still fit his needs?
situations.brief: 환자의 요구를 산정해 열량과 단백 목표를 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's recalculate his calorie and protein needs.
The dietitian can help fine-tune the goals.
We'll adjust the formula to match his condition.
goals: 열량과 단백 목표를 요구에 맞춰 조정한다

situations.title: 위잔여량·촉진제 사용
situations.tagline: Residuals are creeping up — do you want to start a prokinetic?
situations.brief: 위잔여량 증가에 촉진제 사용을 협의하고 반응을 관찰하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's start the prokinetic and reassess residuals.
I'll keep the head of the bed up and monitor.
We'll watch to see if the gut starts moving better.

situations.title: 유문후 급식 전환
situations.tagline: He keeps aspirating — should we place a post-pyloric tube?
situations.brief: 흡인 고위험 환자에서 유문후 급식으로 전환하도록 협력하세요.
keyPhrases: A post-pyloric tube can lower his aspiration risk.
Let's confirm placement before we resume feeds.
I'll keep him elevated and suction ready.
goals: 관 위치를 확인하고 흡인 예방을 유지한다

situations.title: 장허혈 감별 징후
situations.tagline: Her lactate's up and the belly's tense — could the gut be ischemic? Should we hold feeds?
situations.brief: 장허혈을 시사하는 징후를 감별하고 급식 중단 여부를 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: Rising lactate with a tense belly makes me hold feeds.
Let's notify the physician and consider imaging.
We won't feed until ischemia is ruled out.

situations.title: 복부구획증후군 급변 위기
situations.tagline: His bladder pressure is over 25 and he's oliguric — surgery needs to decompress him.
situations.brief: 복부구획증후군 급변에서 감압을 위해 수술팀과 신속히 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: His pressure is critically high with failing kidneys.
I'm calling surgery for urgent decompression.
Let's optimize his sedation and volume meanwhile.

situations.title: 장허혈·괴사 응급
situations.tagline: Her belly's rigid and she's crashing — this looks like dead bowel, we need surgery now.
situations.brief: 장허혈과 괴사가 의심되는 급성 복증에 즉시 대응하고 협력하세요.
keyPhrases: Hold all feeds and start resuscitation now.
I'm calling surgery for an emergent evaluation.
Let's support her pressure and get broad antibiotics.
goals: 장허혈과 괴사 의심 시 즉시 급식을 중단한다

situations.title: 대량 흡인 사건 위기
situations.tagline: She just vomited and aspirated her feeds — sats are dropping, suction now.
situations.brief: 대량 흡인 사건에서 기도를 보호하고 폐렴 위험에 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Turn her and suction the airway right away.
Stop the feed and raise the oxygen now.
I'm calling respiratory and the physician.
goals: 대량 흡인 시 기도를 즉시 보호하고 흡인한다

situations.title: TPN 관련 대사 위기
situations.tagline: His glucose is sky-high and his electrolytes are all over the place on the TPN.
situations.brief: TPN 관련 고혈당과 전해질 급변을 즉시 교정하고 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's adjust the insulin and recheck the glucose.
I'll correct the electrolytes and monitor closely.
We may need to hold or change the TPN rate.
goals: TPN 관련 고혈당과 전해질 급변을 교정한다

situations.title: 심한 재영양증후군 위기
situations.tagline: His phosphate and potassium just bottomed out — this is severe refeeding.
situations.brief: 심한 재영양증후군에서 전해질 붕괴를 신속히 교정하고 급식을 조절하세요.
keyPhrases: Replace the phosphate and potassium urgently.
Let's cut back the feeding rate right now.
I'll monitor his cardiac rhythm closely.

situations.title: 장기 영양불량 예후 소통
situations.tagline: He's wasting away no matter what you feed him — what does that mean for him?
situations.brief: 장기 영양불량 환자의 예후와 치료 목표를 가족과 진솔하게 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Despite full nutrition, his body isn't keeping up.
This tells us his illness is very advanced.
Let's talk about what would give him the most comfort.
